metadataRaw.title: Really Easy Way to Fix a Tension Headache
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a really easy exercise to help relieve a tension headache within 30 seconds. 

A major cause of headaches is due to a build up of tension in the muscles of the upper back and neck. 

This exercise will help quickly release this tension and you can pretty much do it anytime, anywhere (including at work or in class).

Let us know how it works for you!
